messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"book_code":"4BAR","chapter":7,"verses":[{"chapter":7,"text":"1 And Baruch got up and left the tomb and found the eagle sitting outside the tomb.","verse":1},{"chapter":7,"text":"2 And the eagle said to him in a human voice: “Greetings, Baruch, steward of the faith.”","verse":2},{"chapter":7,"text":"3 And Baruch said to him: “You who speak are chosen from among all the birds of heaven, for this is clear from the gleam of your eyes, tell me, then, what are you doing here?”","verse":3},{"chapter":7,"text":"4 And the eagle said to him: “I was sent here so that you can use me to send whatever message you want.”","verse":4},{"chapter":7,"text":"5 And Baruch said to him: “Can you carry this message to Jeremiah in Babylon?”","verse":5}]}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 1,2,3,4,5 in this chapter.
